title: Paper: Great Pyramid concentrates electric fields around the King's Chamber

tellings.quote: there was a paper that came out a while back that talked about the [clears throat] capability of the great pyramid to store and concentrate electric fields directly around the king's chamber.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who studies the pyramids, says a scientific paper came out some time ago showing that the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt can store and concentrate electric fields right around the King's Chamber, a granite room deep inside it. Drumm brings up the paper from memory and does not give its authors or date. If true, it would suggest the pyramid was built to do something with energy, not only to serve as a tomb.
